_comment: YOUR MANDATE. This is what the human authorised. Edit freely, then run:
utterance: order my team lunch, under 900 rupees, from swiggy or zomato
_window: Leave both 0 -- scripts/mandate.sh fills them with a real window.
_budget: PAISE, not rupees. 90000 = Rs 900. Integers only, never floats.
_merchants: Max 64 distinct merchants across all mandates (they live in a bitmask).
_substitution: policy: deny | same_category | any_in_budget. 1500 bp = a substitute may cost up to +15% over the cap. Omit this block entirely for exact-SKU-only.
_constraints: Max 16. 'category' is optional and only used for substitution matching. SKU strings max 48 chars.
